sentences.text: His 2nd bail application was dismissed by the High Court.
Being aggrieved, he approached this Court.
He has already undergone about 2 years in jail.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the respondent(s)-State.
Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, we are of the opinion that a case of bail is made out for the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to be released on bail forthwith on the usual terms and conditions to be decided by the concerned Court.
The present petition shall stand disposed of in the above terms along with pending application(s), if any.

(NIRMALA NEGI) (RENU BALA GAMBHIR)
